en: The beast looked at you in a friendly way and held something out to you.{w}
The beast nodded quietly, then left as silently as it had appeared.{w}
The beast is eyeing you as if you're far too noisy.{w}Being a Silent Beast, perhaps it hates every sound, even the faintest little noise.{w}
{0E}    *  Isn't something making a sound right now?  *    {0F}{w}
note: Centred banner; ASCII spaces in place of the full-width padding (check centring in game).

en: Quietly give your name
Speak to it gently
Sing and dance
Do nothing
Perhaps angered by what you did, the beast made as if to let out a roar and attacked!{w}
note: [JP] (singular 'you') rendered as plain 'you'. 'made as if to roar': the beast is silent, it only goes through the motions.

en: Glaring at you with displeasure, the beast went off deeper into the thicket.{w}
Valkyrie
note: Glossary: [JP] = Valkyrie (class name).

en: "You're seriously going to stand under a waterfall?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'get into a waterfall' unidiomatic; waterfall training = 'stand under' (as 2739, slice 029).

en: "Yeah, I'm going to do some spiritual training.{w}Oh, I know -- why don't you join me?{w}You'll feel refreshed, body and soul!!"{w}
note: Speaker is the Samurai (name box in another slice). | Editorial: spoken phrasing; 'refresh you body and soul' ungrammatical.

en: "Not doing it."{w}
note: Flat refusal [JP] kept curt.

en: While you were waiting at the basin below the falls, Namina showed up late.{w}
note: Editorial: 'finally arrived, running late' redundant.

en: "Sorry to keep you waiting!{w}Well then... I'm off to stand under the falls!"{w}{p}"Everyone, I'm sorry to ask, but if anything comes at me, please drive it off!{w}Well then... here I go!!"{w}
note: Editorial: 'Here goes... now!!' awkward; source repeats sorede wa, so 'Well then' repeats too.

en: "Hiiiiieeeee!?"{w}
Namina's training has begun!{w}
"Bbbbbb, bbh, bbgh, gmph!{w}Nnm-I can't, I caaan't!!"{w}
note: Spluttering under the falls; [JP] = 'I can't'.

en: In an instant, Namina seemed to be chilled right through.{w}You decided to take a while to warm up.{w}
"What do I do? I never knew the training would be this harsh.{w}...I thought it would be easy."{w}{p}"But if I really do see it through, maybe I can change..."{w}{p}".........."{w}
"...I guess I have no choice but to do it.{w}I'll give it my all.{w}After all, you've all come out here for me!!"{w}
Resolved, Namina went back into the falls!!{w}
note: No pronoun for Namina (glossary: script gives no gender).

en: "Bbbbbb!?{w}Bbh, bbgh!? Bbbh, nbbbb!!{w}Bebnabob...!! Babbibabn..."{w}
note: Underwater gibberish. [JP] looks like a garbled [JP] (se-mu-na-do-ku), so 'Bebnabob' garbles 'Semnadoc' (next row: Namina prays to Semnadoc). [JP] left as plain gibberish.

en: Eyes rolling wildly, Namina began to pray toward Semnadoc!!{w}
note: [JP]: the god or the holy city's direction; 'toward Semnadoc' covers both.

en: As you watched over Namina's training, you felt hostile eyes on you from within the forest.{w}{p}All sorts of creatures are gathering to go after the defenseless Namina!{w}
note: Editorial: 'aiming for' a person read oddly.

en: You routed them all.{w}
note: [JP] = 'You routed X' as in earlier slices.

en: When the fighting was over, Namina called out to you from the falls.{w}
"Agagagagaga..."{w}
note: Teeth chattering.

en: You took the violently shaking hand held out to you and pulled Namina out of the falls.{w}
"Hah, hah, everything went hazy...{w}I thought I was going to die... Ugh..."{w}
"But thanks to that, I remembered.{w}Why I came to Semnadoc's holy land..."{w}{p}"Lord Mersenne came to my poor village..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'Semnadoc' (lead convention; earlier slices 028/029 have 'Lord Semnadoc').

en: "...and he passed on Semnadoc's teaching: that no matter how hard things get, you must never stop smiling..."{w}{p}"So this time, I wanted to be the one helping everyone's hearts with that teaching of Semnadoc's. That's why I came to Semnadoc."{w}
note: Subject restored: Mersenne (male) passed on the teaching, continuing the previous row. Last 'Semnadoc' = the holy city. | Editorial: run-on split; 'that teaching' ties back to the smile teaching (sonna).

en: "Aaaargh!! Since when have I been this flighty!!{w}Stupid, stupid me!!"{w}
note: Editorial: dropped 'starry-eyed' (one source word, uwatsuita = frivolous; the pair overstated it, as accuracy flagged).

en: "But I'm wide awake now!{w}Let's go back to Semnadoc!"{w}{p}"If you'll excuse me, I'll go on ahead!"{w}
note: Editorial: word order / natural phrasing.

en: Namina returned to Semnadoc.{w}
You sensed someone's presence beyond the thick fog.{w}The presence took on human shape and slowly drew nearer.{w}
Stay where you are?
The Thing drawing nearer, step by step, is about the same height and build as you.{w}{p}About the same?{w}{p}No. What had appeared was none other than yourselves.{p}
note: [JP] (katakana 'it') rendered 'The Thing'. Source ends with {p} and no {w}; kept. | Editorial: flow of the reveal; 'what appeared was you yourselves' was stiff.

en: You left the spot with a bad aftertaste.{w}
note: Editorial: atonoaji idiom = aftertaste (feeling), not a literal taste in the mouth.

en: You stood on the islet in the middle of the falls and looked around.{w}Just as Leafa said, a beautiful Midnight Rainbow had appeared between the falls and the moon.{w}{p}Then, from the night sky, you heard a strange, croaking voice!{w}
Strange Demon
note: New name box ([JP]); the Lunatic Demon before it names itself.

en: "Ho ho hooo!{w}What a splendid rainbow has come out this time!{w}Now then, now then, my pwecious widdle Moonlight Stone~~~!"{w}{p}"Let's go for a walkie on the Midnight Rainbow togevver~~~~!{w}...Hm?"{w}{p}"Bah, that Leafa!{w}Sending soldiers again, never learning her lesson, eh?{w}Hmm. You look rather shabby for soldiers, though. What's this?"{w}
note: Baby talk to the stone ([JP], [JP]) kept as baby talk. ♪ -> '~'. | Editorial: 'What's this?' was used twice in one row (nanja / hate); first one changed.

en: Lunatic Demon
"I am the one they call the Old Man of the Moon, the Lunatic Demon!{w}You there, which order of knights are you from!?"{w}
note: [JP] singular in form but addressed to the party: plain 'you'.

en: "Whaaaat?{w}The Sweet Ginger Knightsss!?"{w}

"Pfffft! Hee hee hee!!{w}Wh-what kind of name is that for an order of knights!?{w}Wyahahaha!!"{w}{p}"You love Sweet Ginger that much, do you!{w}Do you, eh!? Hyahyahya!!{w}Well, whatever. No matter how many times you come, it's no use!"{w}{p}"A stone as beautiful as this, I'm not about to hand it over to some elf who can't tell its worth!!"{w}{p}"Now, I'm going to bathe it in the rainbow's light, so out of my way!{w}Hohooo!!"{w}
note: Editorial: 'Tee-hee' is girlish (Mistress/Lukoje); wrong effect for the old demon's snicker.

en: You routed the Lunatic Demon.{w}
"Guoooohhh...{w}Y-you lot! What do you think you're doing to a poor, helpless old man!?"{w}{p}"Damn it all, what is the world coming to!{w}I won't forget this, you Sweet Ginger Knightsss!!"{w}
The Lunatic Demon flew away.{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Moonlight Stone.{w}
{0E}      *   The current knocked you off your feet!!   *      {0F}{w}
note: Centred banner; check centring in game. | Editorial: 'swept you off your feet' is a romance idiom; inner padding cut by 1 each side to keep the banner width.

en: *  Finas Rade Elite Guard  *
note: New name: [JP] = 'Elite Guard' (party/encounter banner).

en: You encountered some mysterious people.{w}You feel as though you know each other, and at the same time as though you don't.{w}
*  Council of Isfald Nobles  *
note: New name (encounter banner).

en: *  Trade Winds of Gold, Heart and Fish  *
note: New name: [JP] = trade wind that carries gold, feeling and fish; shortened 'carries' to 'of'.

en: *  The Art of Bodily Labor  *
note: New name: [JP].

en: *  Miracle Reformation  *
note: New name: [JP] (religious reformation).

en: *  Others Party  *
note: New name: [JP].

en: "Grrr... that drunk!{w}My favorite umbrella... and it's brand new, too!!{w}Ugh, honestly!!"{w}
note: Speaker ??? = Lukoje before the name box (next row).

en: Lukoje
"Hey! That's my umbrella, isn't it!!{w}Why have you got it!?{w}Give it back! Give it back to Lukoje!!"{w}
note: Lukoje refers to herself by name; kept.

en: The girl calling herself Lukoje attacked without giving you a chance to speak!!{w}
You routed Lukoje.{w}
"Ow, ow, ow...!!{w}D-don't be so cruel to a girl!{w}My umbrella gets stolen, I get roughed up, waaaah!"{w}
You told her you had come to return the umbrella.{w}
note: Lukoje is female (glossary).

en: "Huh? You came to bring it back?{w}Oh, is that all! Ahaha, so that's what it was.{w}S-sorry for jumping you out of nowhere, okay?"{w}
You returned the umbrella to Lukoje.{w}

"I got such a fright.{w}I was dozing in my room when a drunk suddenly came barging in."{w}{p}"I was watching him, half asleep, and then he just walks out with my umbrella!{w}...Huh, so that old geezer's name is Gary."{w}{p}"Anyway, you remember this too, okay?{w}Things from my world mustn't be taken out into yours, got it?"{w}
note: Gary is male (glossary). The party has presumably told her his name. | Accuracy: [JP] is her own shock at the drunk barging in (next sentence), not something the party did; dropped "You ... gave me".

en: "Hmm hmm hmm~~{w}The dream world is so nice and peaceful~{w}All fluffy and warm... tee-hee."{w}
"Gaaaryyyyyy!!{w}Why does that drunk keep taking my umbrella, night after night!?"{w}
note: Editorial: mainichi mainichi = repeated action, 'keep taking'.

en: Before you is a huge mural.{w}Part of the mural has been scraped away.{w}

note: Pyroglyph cipher text: kept verbatim.
Pyroglyph cipher text kept verbatim; full-width spaces turned into ASCII spaces (as slice 039).

en: ...Nothing happened.{w}
When you carved Urna's name, a soft light enveloped the area.{w}
Before you knew it, a stone tablet had appeared in front of the mural.{w}
note: Editorial: sekihi = 'stone tablet' as in the same scene's continuation (slice 063-065).

en: You gently touched the stone tablet.{w}
note: Editorial: sekihi = 'stone tablet' (slice 063-065).

en: ..........{w}What could this be?{w}Is this really what you struggled so hard to reach?{w}{p}You give the stone tablet a few slaps, but get no further response.{w}
note: Editorial: sekihi = 'stone tablet' (slice 063-065).
